response.query: What domain-adaptation methods (adversarial, feature matching, PSD-augmentations, fine-tuning) most effectively reduce sim-to-real gaps for short noisy cardiac signals?
response.answer: Adversarial training, feature matching, and domain randomization effectively reduce sim-to-real gaps for short noisy cardiac signals. Fine-tuning adjusts model parameters to better fit real data. These methods align synthetic and real signal distributions.
